
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/halfcode/p/20615293" title="发布于 2026-06-18 08:20">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">28. Agent 执行到一半想暂停？用 interrupt 给它设个“关卡“！</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>Agent 跑起来之后，大多数时候我们希望它一气呵成把活干完。但总有些场景不太一样——比如 Agent 要调用一个会删文件的工具，你总得让人确认一下再动手吧？LangGraph 的 interrupt 机制就是干这个的：在指定节点前或节点后暂停执行，等人给了信号再接着跑。</p>
<p>动画视频在<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1bzL96gEkg/" rel="noopener nofollow">《28. Agent 执行到一半想暂停？用 interrupt 给它设个"关卡"！》</a>。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202606/1919157-20260618081721799-1456716039.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;interrupt_before：工具执行前拦截</p>
<p>最常用的场景是 interrupt_before。把它设为 ["<span class="words-blog hl-git-1" data-tit="tools" data-pretit="tools">tools"]，意思是 Agent 调用完模型、决定要用哪个工具之后，先别急着执行，停下来等人发话。配置方式很简单，在 create_agent 里加一个参数就行：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>agent =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_agent(
    model</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">model,
    tools</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[calculate, write_file, read_file, list_dir],
    system_prompt</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你是一个助手，会用工具计算、读写文件、列出目录。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    debug</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">True,
    checkpointer</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">checkpointer,
    interrupt_before</span>=[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tools</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
)</span></pre>
</div>
<p>这里有个前提——必须同时传入 checkpointer。原因很直接：暂停之后要恢复，就得靠 checkpointer 把当前状态存下来，不然中断 了就回不来了。</p>
<p>发送消息，观察暂停效果</p>
<p>配好之后，用 agent.invoke() 发一条消息试试：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>config = {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">configurable</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">thread_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">session-2</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}}
q </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">计算 2024*12+500</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
result </span>= agent.invoke({<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">messages</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: [{<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: q}]}, config=config)</pre>
</div>
<p>运行之后你会发现，Agent 调用模型产生了工具调用请求，但并没有真正执行工具——它停在了 tools 节点之前。result["messages"] 里的最后一条消息，就是 AI 生成的工具调用请求，你可以把它打印出来让用户看看 Agent 接下来打算干什么：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Agent 已暂停，最后消息: {result['messages'][-1].content[:100]}...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p>用 <span class="words-blog hl-git-1" data-tit="Command" data-pretit="command">Command(resume=...) 恢复执行</span></p>
<p>暂停不是目的，关键是暂停之后怎么继续。<span class="words-blog hl-git-1" data-tit="LangGraph" data-pretit="langgraph">LangGraph 提供了一个 Command 对象，通过它的 resume 参数告诉 Agent"可以走了"：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langgraph.types <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Command
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 恢复执行</span>
result = agent.invoke(Command(resume=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">approved</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>), config=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">config)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">答：{result['messages'][-1].content}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p>注意 thread_id 不用换——因为 checkpointer 靠它找到上次暂停时的状态，从<span class="new-words-blog" data-href="https://so.csdn.net/so/search?q=断点" data-report-click="{&quot;spm&quot;:&quot;3001.11407&quot;,&quot;dest&quot;:&quot;https://so.csdn.net/so/search?q=断点&quot;,&quot;extra&quot;:{&quot;wordId&quot;:5450,&quot;businessId&quot;:1,&quot;word&quot;:&quot;断点&quot;,&quot;blogTemplateId&quot;:-1}}" data-report-query="spm=1001.2101.3001.11407" data-tit="断点">断点&nbsp;处继续往下走。</span></p>
<p>如果把这个过程做成交互式的，就是让用户自己决定要不要放行：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 暂停后等待用户输入</span>
user_input = input(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">确认执行？(yes/no): </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> user_input.lower() == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">yes</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    result </span>= agent.invoke(Command(resume=user_input), config=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">config)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 找到最后一条有内容的消息</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> msg <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> reversed(result[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">messages</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> isinstance(msg, ToolMessage):
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">答：{msg.content}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">已取消</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p>用户输入 yes，Agent 就继续调用工具、拿结果、生成回答；输入别的内容，这次工具调用就直接丢弃，流程到此结束。</p>
<p><strong>interrupt_after：工具执行后再拦截</strong></p>
<p>刚才说的是"事前审批"——工具还没跑，先问问人。那如果想在工具跑完之后再加一道关卡呢？把参数从 interrupt_before 换成 interrupt_after 就行，其他代码完全不用动：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>agent =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_agent(
    model</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">model,
    tools</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[calculate, write_file, read_file, list_dir],
    system_prompt</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你是一个助手，会用工具计算、读写文件、列出目录。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    debug</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">True,
    checkpointer</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">checkpointer,
   interrupt_after </span>=[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tools</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
)</span></pre>
</div>
<p>一字之差，执行时机完全不同。interrupt_before 是 Agent 想好要调用什么工具了、但还没动手的时候拦截；interrupt_after 是工具已经跑完了、结果也拿到了，但 Agent 还没把结果送回模型做下一步推理的时候拦截。前者适合"你确定要这么做吗"，后者适合"做完了，你看看结果对不对"。</p>
<p>恢复的方式一模一样：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>user_input = input(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">工具已执行完毕，确认继续？(yes/no): </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> user_input.lower() == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">yes</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    result </span>= agent.invoke(Command(resume=user_input), config=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">config)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 找到最后一条有内容的消息</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> msg <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> reversed(result[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">messages</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> isinstance(msg, ToolMessage):
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">答：{msg.content}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">已取消</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p>把上面的内容串起来，下面是一份可以直接运行的完整代码：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sqlite3
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> dotenv <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> load_dotenv
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain.agents <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_agent, AgentState
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain.agents.middleware <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AgentMiddleware
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain.chat_models <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> init_chat_model
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain_classic.agents <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Agent
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain_community.tools <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> WriteFileTool, ReadFileTool, ListDirectoryTool
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain_core.messages <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AIMessage, ToolMessage
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain_core.tools <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tool, BaseTool
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langgraph.checkpoint.sqlite <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SqliteSaver
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langgraph.runtime <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Runtime
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langgraph.types <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Command
 
load_dotenv()
prefix </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">QWEN</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
model </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> init_chat_model(
    model_provider</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">openai</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    configurable_fields</span>=[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">model</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">api_key</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">base_url</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">],
    config_prefix</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">prefix
).with_config({
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">configurable</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
        f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{prefix}_model</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: os.getenv(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{prefix}_MODEL</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
        f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{prefix}_api_key</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: os.getenv(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{prefix}_API_KEY</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
        f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{prefix}_base_url</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: os.getenv(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{prefix}_BASE_URL</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    }
})
 
 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CalculateTool(BaseTool):
    name: str </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">calculate</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    description: str </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">计算数学表达式的值</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
 
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> _run(self, expression: str) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> str:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">计算结果：{eval(expression)}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">except</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Exception as e:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">计算错误：{str(e)}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
 
    async </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> _arun(self, expression: str) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> str:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self._run(expression)
 
 
calculate </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CalculateTool()
write_file </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> WriteFileTool()
read_file </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ReadFileTool()
list_dir </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ListDirectoryTool()
checkpoint_conn </span>= sqlite3.connect(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">agent.db</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, check_same_thread=False, isolation_level=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">None)
checkpointer </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SqliteSaver(checkpoint_conn)
 
agent </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_agent(
    model</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">model,
    tools</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[calculate, write_file, read_file, list_dir],
    system_prompt</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你是一个助手，会用工具计算、读写文件、列出目录。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    debug</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">True,
    checkpointer</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">checkpointer,
    interrupt_before</span>=[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tools</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
)
config </span>= {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">configurable</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">thread_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">session-2</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}}
 
q </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">计算 2024*12+500</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
result </span>= agent.invoke({<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">messages</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: [{<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: q}]}, config=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">config)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Agent 已暂停，最后消息: {result['messages'][-1].content[:100]}...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 暂停后等待用户输入</span>
user_input = input(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">确认执行？(yes/no): </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> user_input.lower() == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">yes</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    result </span>= agent.invoke(Command(resume=user_input), config=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">config)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 找到最后一条有内容的消息</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> msg <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> reversed(result[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">messages</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> isinstance(msg, ToolMessage):
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">答：{msg.content}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">已取消</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
 
checkpoint_conn.close()</span></pre>
</div>
<p>运行这份代码，你会看到这样的流程：发送问题后，Agent 调用模型、决定使用 calculate 工具，但在执行前暂停；控制台打印出 Agent 打算执行的操作，等待你输入；输入 yes，Agent 继续执行工具调用，计算结果、写文件，最后返回完整回答；输入其他内容，这次调用直接取消。</p>
<p>如果要把暂停点改到工具执行之后，只需要把 interrupt_before=["tools"] 改成 interrupt_after=["tools"]，其他代码一行不用动。</p>
<p>interrupt_before 适合"事前审批"，工具还没跑，先看看 Agent 想干嘛；interrupt_after 适合"事后审查"，工具跑完了，检查一下结果再继续。两种机制配合使用，就能把 Agent 的执行流程牢牢攥在手里。</p>

</div>
